actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so it is reachable via telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 and presents a login prompt, then leave it running.
required_artifacts: A listening localhost TCP service on port 6665
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
The service must be reachable with telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665
Connection should present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying the ISO file exists
Only compiling or printing command output
Only checking that a process started without confirming port readiness
Any check that does not demonstrate the login prompt is reachable
verification_plan: Locate the ISO and determine the correct QEMU invocation
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Preserve receipts for the launch and readiness checks
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing the telnet-visible login prompt
notes: Do not finalize until receipt-backed evidence confirms the original user-facing behavior.
